mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_type AS fileType, LEFT(f.file_text, #{maxLength}) AS fileText, CHAR_LENGTH(f.file_text) AS textLength FROM data_file_status f WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND f.del_flag = '0'

SELECT d.analysis_id AS analysisId, d.analysis_date AS analysisDate, d.subbarcode AS subbarcode, d.barcode AS barcode, d.product AS product, d.product_id AS productId, d.analyzer AS analyzer FROM analysis_data d WHERE d.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND d.del_flag = '0'
